name: Blockstream Satellite
description: Software for interfacing with the Blockstream Satellite network, which broadcasts the Bitcoin blockchain worldwide 24/7 via satellite. Includes CLI/GUI tools and Docker deployment for satellite receivers.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker image available with everything needed to interface with supported satellite receivers. Run blockstream/satellite Docker image with named volumes for persistent configuration.

eval_notes: Unique satellite-blockchain integration. Agents could configure satellite receiver parameters, troubleshoot signal reception, manage Bitcoin data synchronization over satellite links.
